description: This file declares the MockNetworkChangeNotifier class used for testing network change notifications in the Chromium project. It includes methods to simulate network events and manage network state for tests.

classes.name: MockNetworkChangeNotifier
classes.description: A mock class for simulating network change notifications in tests.

classes.name: ScopedMockNetworkChangeNotifier
classes.description: A helper class to replace the singleton NetworkChangeNotifier with a mock for testing.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of MockNetworkChangeNotifier.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the current network connection type.

methods.name: ForceNetworkHandlesSupported
methods.description: Forces the support of network handles.

methods.name: AreNetworkHandlesCurrentlySupported
methods.description: Checks if network handles are supported.

methods.name: SetConnectedNetworksList
methods.description: Sets the list of currently connected networks.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectedNetworks
methods.description: Retrieves the list of current connected networks.

methods.name: NotifyNetworkMadeDefault
methods.description: Notifies observers that a network has become default.

methods.name: QueueNetworkMadeDefault
methods.description: Queues a notification that a network has become default.

methods.name: NotifyNetworkDisconnected
methods.description: Notifies observers that a network has disconnected.

methods.name: QueueNetworkDisconnected
methods.description: Queues a disconnection notification for a network.

methods.name: NotifyNetworkConnected
methods.description: Notifies observers that a network has connected.

methods.name: SetConnectionTypeAndNotifyObservers
methods.description: Sets the connection type and notifies observers.

methods.name: IsDefaultNetworkActiveInternal
methods.description: Checks if the default network is active.

methods.name: SetIsDefaultNetworkActiveInternalForTesting
methods.description: Sets the default network active state for testing.

methods.name: SetUseDefaultConnectionCostImplementation
methods.description: Configures whether to use the default connection cost implementation.

methods.name: ScopedMockNetworkChangeNotifier
methods.description: A RAII class to replace the network change notifier singleton with a mock during tests.
